name: Petrify
description: Petrify device discovery, playback handoff and listening-party relay.
overview: Runs the bundled Petrify relay with Jellyfin, with validated network and party timing settings and an optional browser health check.

versions.changelog: Relay 1.2.8: updated clients can opt into quick Jellyfin authentication and scan the catalog separately; legacy clients retain full catalog responses. Playback handoffs and global Party stop remain supported.
